Name: Rose Iridium Tools and Weapons (plus other upgrades)
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3Ffvnd3.png[/img]

Wow, thank you so much everyone for so many downloads!! (´,,•ω•,,)♡ I never imagined my tool set would go over this well! I'll be adding more to it over time, as well as more options for Generic Mod Config Menu.

This mod replaces all iridium tools with rose iridium variations. I was working off the idea of if iridium had a 'rose' variant, like rose gold. The handles of the tools are deep lavender to fit with the original iridium color, while the blades and main components are rose iridium: pale pink with a light purple and blue sheen. And because everything is better with flowers, I added a rose to each tool to make it literal. („• ᴗ •„)


[b]Matching retextures by other users:[/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24580?tab=description]Rose Iridium Tools for Alternative Textures and Fashion Sense[/url]﻿ by zaoux. 

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36885?tab=description]Rose Iridium Pans for Love of Cooking[/url] by MissHP. 

These users did a fantastic job matching the rosy colors! If you use any of these additional mods I definitely recommend downloading their retextures. (´꒳`)♡



UPDATE: More tools are now included! I recolored all the upgrades to the base tools to have their own rosey themes. The flower appears as a small rose bud on the copper tools, then gets a little larger with each upgrade until it's in full bloom with the iridium tools. The wood handles on the tools have been recolored to rosewood, except for the iridium tools which have iridium handles.

The rose bobber can be selected from the bobbers menu at Willy's shop. Planning to add other cute bobbers in the future.


This ended up being a much larger project than I initially thought, and has taken a lot of troubleshooting to make things work. I'm still very new to modding, so it's been a great learning experience. ^-^ If you do experience any problems, please let me know so I can look into it.


[b]KNOWN ISSUES:
[/b]
[list]
[*][s]Even though I redrew the animation frames for using the fishing rod, the game applies the color of the default rod overtop it and I have no idea how to prevent this. If I figure it out then I'll include the fix in an update. For now, the only way I know of to make the recolor show while fishing is to use the Fiberglass Rod, since it's colorless.[/s] This problem can be solved by installing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25258]Colorful Fishing Rods[/url]﻿ by 6480. No other action is needed to set it up, my mod should automatically set the color to the appropriate values.
[/list]
[list]
[*]If you use Fashion Sense sleeves or body type and have a short/girl character, the panning animation will always display the rose iridium pan. This has to do with how the files are set up for Fashion Sense. The panning animation only has one color set instead of four. I haven't been able to find any way around this, so I'm sorry for that inconsistency. Also, if you use sleeves created by another user the pan shown in the animation will likely be different. The panning animation is part of the arms spritesheet, so any changes to the arms/sleeves will also change the pan shown in the animation. 
[/list]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/B92L7co.png[/img]


[b]HOW TO INSTALL:[/b]

To install the mod, copy "[CP] Rose Iridium Tools and Weapons by Luny" into your StardewValley/mods folder. Make sure you have Smapi and Content Patcher up to date.

[b]If you don't use Fashion Sense or don't care about the recolor on the panning animation, you don't have to do anything else.[/b]

If you use a Fashion Sense original body and you want the recolor of the pan to show in the panning animation, just copy and paste the "FashionSense" folder into the same location as the Fashion Sense mod (typically StardewValley/mods). If done correctly, you should get a prompt to replace files. Choose yes to replace them, and you're good to go!

The files being replaced are the two images that contain the sprites for the panning animation. The pan is the only change to the files.





If you'd like to see updates on my projects, check out [url=https://ko-fi.com/looneyluny]my page on Kofi[/url]﻿﻿! You can also buy me a coffee if you like, but don't feel obligated!
